comment_reports_resolution_check.name: comment_reports_resolution_check
comment_reports_resolution_check.value: ("comment_reports"."resolved_at" IS NULL) = ("comment_reports"."resolution" IS NULL) AND ("comment_reports"."resolution" IS NULL OR "comment_reports"."resolution" IN ('removed', 'dismissed'))

picks_note_check.name: picks_note_check
picks_note_check.value: "picks"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("picks"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 280

recommendation_feedback_target_check.name: recommendation_feedback_target_check
recommendation_feedback_target_check.value: ("recommendation_feedback"."kind" = 'not_interested' AND "recommendation_feedback"."video_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recommendation_feedback"."channel_id" IS NULL) OR ("recommendation_feedback"."kind" = 'hide_channel' AND "recommendation_feedback"."channel_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recommendation_feedback"."video_id" IS NULL)

video_screenings_open_idx.name: video_screenings_open_idx
video_screenings_open_idx.where: ("video_screenings"."decision" IS NULL AND "video_screenings"."outcome" = 'HOLD') OR ("video_screenings"."flags" <> '[]'::jsonb AND "video_screenings"."flags_cleared_at" IS NULL)

video_screenings_purge_idx.name: video_screenings_purge_idx
video_screenings_purge_idx.where: "video_screenings"."decision" IS NOT NULL AND "video_screenings"."evidence_purged_at" IS NULL
